archetype: LUXURY WEDDING x AI IRIDESCENT LIQUID GLASS
logo_style_description: Dreamy iridescent liquid aesthetic with soft pastel gradients (lavender, powder blue, baby pink, blush, soft coral, champagne cream, cyan, subtle violet, pearlescent white).

typography.hero_title: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-light tracking-tight leading-tight

liquid_gradient_styles.liquid_orb_1: w-72 h-72 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#C9B8FF] via-[#F7B7D8] to-[#A9E8FF] blur-3xl opacity-60 animate-pulse
liquid_gradient_styles.liquid_orb_2: w-96 h-96 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-tr from-[#F5A9B8] via-[#A9E8F4] to-[#FFF8EF] blur-3xl opacity-50
liquid_gradient_styles.thinking_orb: w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#C9B8FF] via-[#F7B7D8] to-[#A9E8FF] animate-spin blur-[1px]

key_features_and_sections.title: Floating Glass Navigation
key_features_and_sections.description: Sticky top bar with WEDORA iridescent logo image, navigation menu items (AI Chat, Wedding Designer, Budget Architect, Venues, How it Works), and 'Launch AI Assistant' primary CTA button.

key_features_and_sections.title: Hero AI Chat Showcase
key_features_and_sections.description: Expressive headline 'Your Intelligent Digital Wedding Companion', liquid pastel gradient background, centerpiece Apple liquid glass chat search bar, suggested prompt chips, and interactive demo chat thread.

key_features_and_sections.title: Wedding AI Capabilities
key_features_and_sections.description: 8 interactive pearlescent glass cards with soft pastel icons: Theme Generator, Budget Architect, Vendor Concierge, Floral & Decor Designer, Guest & RSVP Assistant, Timeline Master, Attire Matcher, Vow & Speech Writer.

key_features_and_sections.title: AI Wedding Designer Studio
key_features_and_sections.description: Interactive design builder where users choose theme parameters (Mandap, Stage, Entrance, Lighting, Florals, Palette) and watch AI generate instant visual moodboards and design proposals.

key_features_and_sections.title: Interactive Budget Planner
key_features_and_sections.description: Live budget estimator with total budget slider, guest count input, priority selector, and interactive cost breakdown visualization by category.

key_features_and_sections.title: Venue & Vendor Discovery
key_features_and_sections.description: Search and filter top curated wedding venues & vendors with filter chips (Palace, Beachfront, Garden, Intimate), rating tags, price tier badges, and interactive inquiry modals.

key_features_and_sections.title: How WEDORA Works
key_features_and_sections.description: 4-step horizontal process (Describe Vision -> AI Magic Generation -> Customize & Refine -> Connect & Execute) connected by a flowing pastel gradient line.

key_features_and_sections.title: AI Prompt Examples Carousel
key_features_and_sections.description: Clickable prompt chips across 4 categories (Budget, Decor, Schedule, Vows) that instantly populate the AI chat interface.

key_features_and_sections.title: Final CTA with Glowing Orb
key_features_and_sections.description: High impact call-to-action block centered around a large glowing iridescent liquid orb with glass card overlay and 'Start Planning Free' button.

key_features_and_sections.title: Luxury Footer
key_features_and_sections.description: Brand statement, links, newsletter signup with liquid glass input, copyright, social icons.

instructions_to_main_agent.file_type: JavaScript / React (.js, .jsx). DO NOT create .tsx files unless explicitly requested.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_requirement: EVERY interactive button, input, tab, modal trigger, card, select, and key text metric MUST have a descriptive data-testid attribute in kebab-case format (e.g. data-testid='chat-input-field', data-testid='send-message-button', data-testid='budget-slider').
styling_rules: Use soft, warm pearlescent off-white backgrounds (#FAF8F6 or #FDFBF7).
Do NOT use pure black or dark theme. This is an iridescent liquid pastel wedding theme.
Use Lucide-react or Phosphor icons for smooth UI adornments.
Header MUST be fixed/sticky with glassmorphism backdrop-blur-xl and z-50.
The Apple liquid glass chat bar must feature specular inner highlights, white-to-pastel border gradients, and smooth transition physics.
Chat interface must respond dynamically to user prompt clicks, suggested chips, and custom input with interactive AI streaming text / thinking animation.
